mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates above 6.5% indicate a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%, or the correlation between UNRATE and SPX returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05) or SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both series rise.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, elevated federal funds rates above 0.5% signal reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor in tightening cycles is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth indicates a healthy labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS is rising, or the correlation between PAYEMS and SPX returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation above 2.5% as measured by CPIAUCSL signals potential monetary tightening, which increases real interest rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth combined with robust GDP expansion indicates a healthy supply-side economy that supports corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of INDPRO and GDPC1 on SPX returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05) or SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both series rise over the past quarter.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, strong housing starts and retail sales growth signal economic overheating, prompting expectations of monetary tightening that depress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when the late-cycle expansion regime is active, or the interaction effect between HOUST and RSAFS is not statistically significant (p>0.05).
